    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v!=0)
    bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rs=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if bg not in row]
    cs=[c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]!=bg for r in range(h))]

        row=[]

            vals=[grid[r][c] for r in (rs[i],rs[i+1]) for c in (cs[j],cs[j+1])]
            row.append(vals[0] if vals[0]!=0 and len(set(vals))==1 else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v!=0)
    bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rs=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if bg not in row and any(v not in (0,bg) for v in row)]
    cs=[c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]!=bg for r in range(h)) and any(grid[r][c] not in (0,bg) for r in range(h))]
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(rs)-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(cs)-1):
            vals=[grid[r][c] for r in (rs[i],rs[i+1]) for c in (cs[j],cs[j+1])]
            row.append(vals[0] if vals[0]!=0 and len(set(vals))==1 else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
ans=transform(grid)

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_lines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                 if background not in row and any(v not in (0, background) for v in row)]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w)
                 if all(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(h))
                 and any(grid[r][c] not in (0, background) for r in range(h))]
    output = []
    for i in range(len(row_lines) - 1):
        out_row = []
        for j in range(len(col_lines) - 1):
            values = [grid[r][c] for r in (row_lines[i], row_lines[i + 1])
                      for c in (col_lines[j], col_lines[j + 1])]
            out_row.append(values[0] if values[0] != 0 and len(set(values)) == 1 else background)
        output.append(out_row)
    return output
